test_programs.policy: Run all eight pinned division and remainder programs. Each issues division requests and checks architectural results; no private algorithm or cycle count is required. A second divider in the fixed MulDiv observes accepted requests and result transfers across flush and downstream backpressure.

comparison.pass_condition: Every selected program completes with zero RTL-versus-ISA trace mismatches. The separate port observation in rv64um-p-divu must complete with correct request information, quotients and remainders, and no result from a cancelled request.

fixed_test_patches.purpose: Observe result transfers following flush and during legal downstream backpressure.
